_about: Golden request-dispatcher vectors generated from kid_pc_monitor.request_dispatcher by tests/dispatcher_vectors_gen.py. Do not edit by hand.

children.name: get
args: get a single variable or "settings" to get all variables

children.name: set
args: set a single variable to a new value

children.name: extend
args: add minutes of extra allowance for today (val=minutes)

children.name: message
args: show a popup message on the PC (val=text)

children.name: shutdown
args: shut down the PC after a warning (val=seconds, default 60)

children.name: get_logs
args: read the agent log file (tail=N lines, default 500, max 5000)

children.name: current_user
args: read-only, the username of the currently logged-in user

children.name: bed_time
args: bed time, at which the computer will be locked

children.name: manual_lock
args: boolean, whether a manual lock is in effect

children.name: wake_time
args: time, at which the computer can be used the following morning

children.name: cumulative_extension
args: read-only, a running total of extension seconds today

children.name: accumulated_seconds
args: read-only, a running total of active seconds used today

children.name: enforcement_active
args: read-only, whether schedule/limit enforcement is active

children.name: enforcement_reason
args: read-only, brief reason when enforcement is active (or null)

children.name: access_status
args: read-only, brief overall access status for the parent panel

error.message: cannot read log file: disk on fire

log_lines: quote " and \ backslash
